parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Figures taken from the Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation table ($ in thousands). Summary slides show the same amounts in millions ($56.8 vs $47.9). The quarterly chart also shows Q2–Q4 2025 values ($52.4, $58.0, $58.0 million), but no full-year total is printed. Kadant's fiscal Q1 actually ends around the end of March (e.g., March 28), so the 03-31 period-end dates are approximate. Segment figures were excluded.
